project.purpose: Represent divergent Git history as read-only source-cut-bound typed LEGO records; never infer semantic consumer acceptance or authorize main reset/branch deletion.

nodes.label: SourceHistoryGraphProjection
nodes.responsibility: Project exact local/remote Git commit DAG, patch relation, canonical owner mapping and path evidence, including merge deltas distinct from all parents.
nodes.authority: Git object graph and existing tools/repo/owners.toml
acceptance: Every represented commit binds immutable left/right SourceCut identities and one canonical natural Owner projection, or the operator fails closed.
Independent merge-result path changes remain visible and consumerQualification is UNKNOWN_REQUIRES_OWNER_CDC without separate Owner contract proof.
The existing native test_source_history_legos.py and repository CI pass on the candidate source cut.
Identical unique cross-path Git Blob/mode matches are represented without asserting historical rename intent, path consumer equivalence or automatic deletion; duplicates remain ambiguous.

Retired document currentness, one-off first-contact evaluators and historical live-view tools are not source-of-truth; existing architecture checker remains and a negative CDC rejects their reintroduction.

ROOT_UNOWNED means no matching path in the protected SourceCut Owner manifest, not an inferred root Owner. For those paths the graph partitions exact local/remote tip presence into BOTH_PRESENT, LOCAL_ONLY, REMOTE_ONLY and BOTH_ABSENT; none establishes consumer equivalence or branch-retirement permission.
nodes.nextAction: Per-Owner Consumer-Driven Contract qualification of surviving divergent histories; no redundant Git scanner.

slices.label: DivergentMainSourceHistory
acceptance: Native Git projection covers both exclusive DAG sides and refuses ambiguous common ancestors rather than selecting arbitrary lineage.
Projected equality may skip redundant cherry-picks for exact source paths, never approve deletion or imply behavior equality.
Owner-native test_source_history_legos.py validates NUL-delimited paths, merge paths, source-bound owners and fail-closed edges.
blockers: Consumer semantic equivalence remains UNKNOWN until corresponding natural-Owner CDC is proven.
slices.nextAction: Select and test only novel consumer behavior in recorded Git cuts.
